def transform(grid):
    # Count marked cells in each tile; in the demonstration, count 1 maps to
    # 5 and count 2 maps to 1. Tiles are separated by full lines of 6.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rs = [i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    cs = [j for j in range(w) if all(row[j] == 6 for row in grid)]
    r_bounds = [-1] + rs + [h]
    c_bounds = [-1] + cs + [w]
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(r_bounds,r_bounds[1:]):
        row=[]
        for x,y in zip(c_bounds,c_bounds[1:]):
            n=sum(v==5 for rr in grid[a+1:b] for v in rr[x+1:y])
            row.append(5 if n==1 else 1)
        out.append(row)
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    row_seps=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r))==1]
    col_seps=[j for j in range(w) if len({r[j] for r in grid})==1]
    rb=[-1]+row_seps+[h]; cb=[-1]+col_seps+[w]
    sep_colors={grid[i][0] for i in row_seps}|{grid[0][j] for j in col_seps}

                counts[grid[i][j]]=counts.get(grid[i][j],0)+1
